criteria.decision: dense>=fit_gate and sparse<=fit_low -> supervision_density_is_the_wall; dense>=fit_gate and sparse>=fit_gate -> both_learn; dense<=fit_low and sparse<=fit_low -> line_closed_matching_not_learnable; else inconclusive_density
criteria.shared: both arms use the P3.24 soft-centroid readout with tau initialised at 0.02, declared before any reading; the loss cannot soften it the way it did in P3.25 because the floor is 1e-3 and the init is already sharp
criteria.single_variable: the two arms differ only by the auxiliary 17-way column cross-entropy (16 columns plus null) against the public locator
criteria.why_not_standardisation: an instance-standardised score would remove the absolute match scale that the abstention term needs, so a sharp tau is declared instead

control_arms.p3_24: same readout with tau 1.0 and no aux: train 0.250, fit 0.250, entropy log 256
control_arms.p3_25: decoded colour with tau 1.0: withdrawn, entropy log 256 at 400 steps

note: pricing stage; run needs frozen status plus owner authority plus a measured cap

withdrawal.when: after pricing, before freezing; no card reading was produced
withdrawal.reason: five implementations each found a different escape, and the fifth showed the obstacle is in the readout family rather than in a parameter

revisions.change: tau 0.02 with the null term on the mean-score scale
revisions.observed: null dominated every column: dense head 8/32 on fit, 64/256 on train
both arms flat at 0.250 with entropy log 256

revisions.change: max-subtracted column logits plus a free presence coefficient
revisions.observed: dense train 14->24->42 of 256 by 400 steps, then 56->62->63 by 2500, i.e. converged on always-null (63 of 64 unknown cases)

revisions.change: bounded nearest-pixel column evidence with a constant abstention
revisions.observed: dense head exactly 64/256; the decoded target drifted to [0.708,-0.256,0.738], a negative green channel that no pixel can match

revisions.change: sigmoid gamut constraint on the decoded target
revisions.observed: dense head still exactly 64/256, fit 7/32, attention entropy 0.96

withdrawal.reading: the answer is a function of a discrete selection, so the centroid is piecewise constant in the selection variable; a smooth relaxation gives a diffuse mixture gradient and the class prior or the abstention term is always a cheaper descent direction
withdrawal.note: the criteria were never exercised, so no verdict is claimed; the card contributes the five escape modes, not a result about the task
